as first from_json first/first.json
as second from_json second/second.json

# merge: each way of joining lists
as merged merge @first $second
to_json @merged
as replaced merge @first $second --lists replace
equals @merged $replaced
as joined merge @first $second --lists concat
to_json @joined
as united merge @first $second --lists union
to_json @united
as back merge @second $first --lists concat
to_json @back
as twice merge @first $first --lists union
equals @first $twice
as none obj
as onto merge @none $first --lists concat
equals @first $onto
as under merge @first $none --lists union
equals @first $under

# merge: what it refuses
merge @first $second --lists sorted
merge @first $second --lists
merge @first $second --arrays union
